verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents a git-backed workflow. Bi-directional sync creates a two-way connection with a GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket repository, and a workflow guide says you can 'run documentation entirely through Git, with Markdown and OpenAPI in your repository and pull requests as the review step'. ReadMe branches also hold changes back from the live hub until approved. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that git branches map to ReadMe branches and that merging is what triggers publishing, plus independent or hands-on confirmation of the sync workflow.
